summary: Before RC freeze, two consecutive package builds from the same debug-log-free product source produced identical 277076-byte 0.2.1 VSIX files with SHA-256 3e23ba0a75b49dd4bfbb645d7296d68d5e882cf303078aeefdcf574c61530aba; final EVID-018 independently reconfirmed 58 bootstrap files and 118 VSIX entries.
